onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/acceleration.schema.json, set mv_c_accel_enabled to {{mv_c_accel_enabled}}]
Set acceleration mode to {{mv_c_accel_enabled}}. Instant=enableAcceleration false (legacy damping). Smooth=enableAcceleration true (AccelerationCurve).

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/acceleration.schema.json, set mv_c_air_control to {{mv_c_air_control}}]
Set air control to {{mv_c_air_control}}. Light=airControlFactor~1.2. Normal=2.0. Heavy=4.0.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/acceleration.schema.json, set mv_t_accel_time to {{mv_t_accel_time}}]
Set MovementAbility.accelerationTime to {{mv_t_accel_time}} seconds. Current: decel_factor={{mv_t_decel_factor}}

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/acceleration.schema.json, set mv_t_decel_factor to {{mv_t_decel_factor}}]
Set MovementAbility.decelerationFactor to {{mv_t_decel_factor}}. Higher = stop/reverse faster. Current: accel_time={{mv_t_accel_time}}

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/acceleration.schema.json, set mv_t_air_factor to {{mv_t_air_factor}}]
Set MovementAbility.airControlFactor to {{mv_t_air_factor}}. Higher = less responsive air steering. Current: accel_time={{mv_t_accel_time}}
